summary: Comprehensive diagnostic sweep of Script-to-Gear marketplace completed. All 44 backend API tests passed (100%). All 12 frontend pages load correctly with proper UI elements, navigation, and user authentication. The application is production-ready with both filmmaker and rental house workflows fully functional.
critical_code_review_comments: All API endpoints properly validate user authentication via session tokens (cookie or header)
Role-based access control is correctly enforced - filmmakers cannot create gear, rental houses cannot create projects
Projects endpoint correctly returns 403 when accessed by non-owner
Lead creation validates both project ownership and supplier role (must be rental_house)
Stripe checkout and payment flow works in test mode with sk_test_emergent key
AI analysis via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY works and returns gear recommendations with proper error handling
Profile update validates name length (min 2 chars) and returns 400 for invalid input
All UI pages have proper dark theme with good contrast and maroon accent color
Sidebar navigation works correctly for both filmmaker and rental house roles
